emailTemplate.name: Capitec Booking Email Verification
emailTemplate.defaultTextTemplate:
[#setting url_escaping_charset="UTF-8"]Hello ${user.firstName!'there'},

Please verify your email address before signing in to Capitec Branch Booking.

__EMAIL_VERIFY_BASE_URL__/${verificationId}?tenantId=${tenant.id}

If you did not create this account, you can ignore this email.

lambda.name: Add profile claims to access token
lambda.body: function populate(jwt, user, registration) { if (user.email) { jwt.email = user.email; } if (user.firstName || user.lastName) { jwt.name = ((user.firstName || '') + ' ' + (user.lastName || '')).trim(); } if (registration && registration.roles) { jwt.roles = registration.roles; jwt.groups = registration.roles; } }

theme.name: Capitec Booking
theme.stylesheet: :root{--capitec-primary:#0066B3;--capitec-primary-dark:#004F8C;--capitec-accent:#00A3E0;--capitec-ink:#071D38;--capitec-ink-soft:#41516A;--capitec-bg:#F3F6FA;--capitec-card:#FFFFFF;--capitec-border:#DDE5EF;--capitec-success:#1B6E3E;--capitec-radius:12px;}html,body{background:var(--capitec-bg) !important;font-family:'Inter','Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif !important;color:var(--capitec-ink) !important;}body{min-height:100vh;}main,.container,.page,.background,.wrapper{background:transparent !important;}.panel,.card,.box,.login-form,form{background:var(--capitec-card) !important;border:1px solid var(--capitec-border) !important;border-radius:var(--capitec-radius) !important;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(7,29,56,.10) !important;padding:2rem !important;}h1,h2,h3,.title,.heading,legend{color:var(--capitec-ink) !important;font-weight:700 !important;letter-spacing:0 !important;}h1,.title{font-size:1.55rem !important;line-height:1.2 !important;}p,.muted,.help{color:var(--capitec-ink-soft) !important;line-height:1.6 !important;}label{color:var(--capitec-ink-soft) !important;font-weight:600 !important;font-size:.9rem !important;}input[type='text'],input[type='email'],input[type='password'],input[type='number'],select,textarea{background:#FFFFFF !important;border:1px solid var(--capitec-border) !important;border-radius:10px !important;padding:.75rem .9rem !important;color:var(--capitec-ink) !important;transition:border-color .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease;}input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{border-color:var(--capitec-primary) !important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,102,179,.14) !important;outline:none !important;}.button,button,input[type='submit'],.btn,.btn-primary,a.button{background:var(--capitec-primary) !important;border:none !important;color:#FFFFFF !important;border-radius:999px !important;padding:.8rem 1.5rem !important;font-weight:700 !important;letter-spacing:0 !important;text-transform:none !important;box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(0,102,179,.22) !important;transition:background .15s ease,transform .05s ease;}.button:hover,button:hover,input[type='submit']:hover,.btn:hover{background:var(--capitec-primary-dark) !important;}.button:active,button:active{transform:translateY(1px);}a,.link{color:var(--capitec-primary) !important;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;}a:hover{color:var(--capitec-primary-dark) !important;text-decoration:underline;}.alert,.error,.help-block{border-radius:10px !important;}.alert-error,.error{background:#FFF5F5 !important;color:#A12828 !important;border:1px solid #F2C9C9 !important;}.alert-success,.success{background:#EFFAF4 !important;color:var(--capitec-success) !important;border:1px solid #CDEBD8 !important;}.brand,.logo{color:var(--capitec-primary) !important;}hr{border-color:var(--capitec-border) !important;}
